reviews.text: Thank you so much for taking such good care of my baby and treating her with so much love! ❤️ I recently moved to the neighbourhood, and this vet clinic was recommended to me. I’m so happy I found this place! The service was excellent, and the staff were so kind, caring, and loving. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a vet who truly cares about their pets! 🐾❤️

Dear Reviewer,

We take all feedback seriously and strive to provide the highest standard of veterinary care and customer service. However, your review does not include any comments or details that would help us understand your concerns, and we have been unable to identify a corresponding client visit based on the information available to us.

We would welcome the opportunity to understand your experience and address any concerns you may have. Please contact Harbourfront Animal Hospital directly so we can look into this matter appropriately.

Thank you,
HAH team

UPDATE: September 25, 2026: In response to the hospital's statement that they have no record of my visit, I have attached a copy of my invoice confirming that Rocky received care at your facility. I previously contacted the hospital by email regarding my concerns and have not received a response. I'm disappointed that my experience has been publicly questioned rather than addressed.
————————————————————————
Don’t go to this clinic. My experience felt like a total money grab, and I left with very little confidence in the care my dog received.

This was my newly adopted dog’s first wellness exam, and I specifically brought him in because I was concerned about his breathing. I was told his breathing was fine. I sought a second opinion shortly afterward, and that vet diagnosed him with a lung infection and nasal mites. On top of that, I was given conflicting information about recommended blood work and cost, an age estimate that was significantly different from the second vet’s assessment, and I never received the follow-up I was promised. The vet didn’t record any notes during the exam to establish a baseline health history either.

I emailed the clinic afterward with my concerns and they never responded. I would not trust this clinic with my dog again, and I would strongly recommend getting a second opinion if something doesn’t feel right.

I never had any attachment to Dr. Debski. But he was a veterinarian who I could trust to do his job well, with compassion, communication, and punctually.

Diana is great, and I appreciate that she's there to provide a friendly atmosphere—she's why they get 2 stars. But the new owners are anything but punctual, put the squeeze on your wallet, and show a lack of compassion in even the worst of circumstances. I generally try to be understanding, but it's so much more transactional and clinical—not to mention without respect for your time.

The team is absolutely amazing and took great care of my Coco. They were competent, kind, careful and above all else professional. We really felt taken care of and Coco now is a new dog with even more purpose. If you’re looking for a new vet in the downtown core, I couldn’t recommend this team any more highly of a choice. Best decision I’ve made!

Really nice and friendly staff, and a very professional and caring doctor Dr. Adel Williams. They were patient with my cat, explained the treatment plan clearly, and made sure I understood the different options before proceeding. I really appreciated how thoughtful and attentive everyone was throughout the visit. Overall, a very positive experience and I would definitely recommend this clinic.

The best clinic for animals in downtown Toronto, my friend was visiting from Europe with her pet and the doctor was so professional with taking care of her pet very clean very organized. We were so happy with our experience and the new team is amazing.

I cannot praise the team at Harbourfront Animal Hospital enough. They saw my cat, Pepper, for two last minute emergency visits that could have been disastrous if not for their intervention. They are kind, caring, and so warm, and that’s before I even talk about the services they provide. They took such great care of Pepper, and made sure that we were entirely informed about his diagnosis and treatment instructions. I’m beyond grateful for the vet techs and Dr. Williams. You should all be so proud of the team you’ve created. I look forward to bringing Pepper back for all of his future check-ups (but hopefully no more emergency visits are needed!)
Incredible forensic quality and care to get to the heart (or the kidney) of the matter!!!

New vet took over and the way they run things is not up to my standards at all. Wasn’t even informed of the change. I was very happy with the last vet team as they were closely following my cats weight loss process. That has been completely lost in the transition. I just switched to Harbourfront in January while searching for someone who can be more consistent with my cats journey. They can’t even make sure to have his food which was ordered weeks ago. On top of that their attention seems more concerned with teaching things to the vets son who doesn't know how to do anything. He left the door open during a checkup with my cat and had to be told to close the door cause cats are fast. Won’t be back. The front desk girl is carrying the whole team, hope she’s paid appropriately.

Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful that you chose Harbourfront Animal Hospital. We look forward to caring for you and your pet again in the future.

Harbourfront Animal Hospital is truly and incredibly an excellent animal hospital.

I walked in on a Friday, booked an appointment for my dog for the following Monday and by Thursday, my dog had the necessary surgery she needed. They treated my dog as their own and the care surpassed anything I was expecting.

I cannot sing their praises enough, the superb customer service and care that Harbourfront Animal Hospital provides, is way beyond what I expected.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

THREE YEAR UPDATE;

I've been going here for 3 years now with my babies. 2 years ago we discovered my one baby was diabetic. It was a big shocked but we adjusted to the treatment (Senvelgo). Photo of said baby.
The vet that did handle this has retired/left and Dr.Williams has taken his place and I cannot stop to thank them enough for how patient they've been with me as I know I have bad anxiety. Not only has my baby gotten surgery this month on a growth we spotted months ago that grew, but her Senvelgo seems to not be working effectively anymore from the blood and urine tests from surgery. They have been so patient with me coming by with questions, taking time to sit with me and go over things without an appointment. They even let me bring her to be looked at on the front desk super quick when she had vomiting after surgery and they were slammed.
Having a vet practice being taken over by new faces can be a little scary, but they already made me feel comfortable right away. Ania is also so sweet and takes her time. You can really see how much she does love animals. There's always bumps with new rules with new faces (paying in advance for orders, etc), but that's life sometimes.
After 3 years I still do recommend this place with 5 stars for myself. If you live in the area its really nice (I live in the connected building which is a HUGE bonus for emergencies).

-----

Amazing vet!
Just started taking my cats here. The front desk is always so friendly and welcoming. The vet is also amazing, very patient with my scared cat. Also doesn't make me feel pressured to jump right into tests or procedures and understands the costs and that some people may not have that money right away.

Reviews aren’t only for sharing complaints—they’re also for recognizing outstanding service! The entire team was absolutely wonderful: welcoming, professional, and genuinely caring.

As someone who is not Canadian, I especially appreciated how much time they took to explain everything clearly and thoroughly, making sure I fully understood every step of the process. Despite my cat being quite anxious and restless, they remained patient, understanding, and reassuring throughout the visit, which made a huge difference for both of us.

A compassionate, knowledgeable, and dedicated team that I would recommend without hesitation. Thank you again for your exceptional care and support! 🐾❤️
I’m very happy that I found this hospital, my cat is usually very scared but they made him very comfortable and relaxed. The process was really smooth. Highly recommended 😌 …

Last month our beautiful dog started to avoid his food and stopped playing the way he used to we were so concerned about his wellbeing. We have been taking him to the harbourfront animal hospital but this time was different, he was genuinely sick and the care he received right from the start, the vet and the staff (Dr Williams, Anya, Diana and Nicole) was so heartwarming to see. He was admitted for a day and received such phenomenal care and since then, they have been available to answer any questions we had.

10/10 recommend for your furry friends and if it’s on Diana’s list, it will be done! ^_^
I always bring my cat for her vaccines here. Dr. Williams, Diane, and Ania are all great! Thanks a lot.

I have been taking my cat to Harbourfromt since I got him at 6 months old, he is now 5. They have always given exceptional care, followed up with any urgent matters, and connected me to an amazing cat sitter that I use whenever I am out of the city. My cat and I love Harbourfront staff and the vet himself.
Amazing service!
Anna, make sure you deal with her

Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review! We are delighted to hear that you had a positive experience with our team. Providing compassionate care and clear communication for both pets and their families is always our top priority.

We truly appreciate your trust in Harbourfront Animal Hospital and look forward to caring for your pet for many years to come. Thank you for taking the time to share your experience!
Great experience with teeth cleaning and general care, really trust them. Vet was great and would recommend!!

When my dogs usual vet couldn’t get her in and redirected me to emergency I called Harbourfront Animal hospital and they were able to get her in within an hour. My pug was suffering from Pyometra which is lethal. All the staff and the vet were so comforting, acted quick and saved her life. They explained everything, give estimates prior to doing anything and while I was a crying mess really made me feel comforted. A huge thank you to everyone, from front desk, vet techs and the vet. Won’t be taking my dogs anywhere else!

All staff were excellent with my cat Duke thus ensuring that he remained very calm, and and was not stressed. The vet Dr. Williams, was very thorough and explained the diagnosis fully along with the options for treatment. Anya was amazing with Duke as she gave him his injection and first dose of antibiotics. An excellent experience all around!

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with Harbourfront Animal Hospital.

Our team is dedicated to providing compassionate care for every pet and their family, and it means a lot to know we were able to help. We look forward to seeing you and your furry companion again in the future!

– The Harbourfront Animal Hospital Team

Absolutely disappointed, Ihave been with them 8 years, and the my last two visits it was only about the money.
Different vets saw my 2 dogs and I was told next time I come for vaccinations only but another vet decided to do another check up on my two dogs although I told her over and over again that I was there two weeks ago and check up was done but she only wanted to charge me again although there was no need for that.

It is only business now.

So be careful to deal with one vet  only and always check what they want to do or you will be charged for unnecessary things and charges.

Harbourfront Animal Hospital stands out for its consistently professional and compassionate approach to veterinary care. The team is attentive and approachable, with a clear focus on making both pets and their owners feel comfortable and well supported.

The veterinarians take the time to explain things clearly and thoroughly, which helps build trust and confidence in the care provided. The clinic itself is clean, modern, and well organized, contributing to a smooth and low-stress experience overall.

What really stands out is the way animals are handled—with patience, gentleness, and genuine care. It’s evident that the team values the well-being of pets and treats them with the respect they deserve.

Overall, Harbourfront Animal Hospital is a strong option for anyone looking for reliable, skilled, and compassionate veterinary care.

I had a great experience at Harbourfront Animal Hospital. Dr. Williams is knowledgeable, compassionate, and takes the time to explain everything clearly. The staff are friendly, professional, and genuinely care about both pets and their owners. The clinic is well-organized and welcoming, which made the whole visit smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend their services!

I've been a customer for almost 15 years - my pooch was a pup and one of the first customers when the clinic open, now he is an old man. Dr Debski frequently went above and beyond offering free services and solutions when we struggled with hard-to-treat issues. Overall, we've got great, thoughtful support for almost 15 years.
Thank you!
Amazing care , the vet is very compassionate and the team professional. Great experience
Amazing experience! The staff were kind, professional, and truly caring with my dog. They made us feel comfortable and went above and beyond. Highly recommend this clinic!
Great experience!

I brought my dog in to induce vomiting after he swallowed a balloon. When staff took him to the back, they dragged him across the floor because he didn’t want to leave me, instead of simply picking him up—he weighs only 14 lbs.

When it came time to pay, I was hit with a long list of charges. After he finished purging, they insisted on keeping him for an additional 15 minutes and billed both cage time ($51) and technician time ($51) for that period. $380 bill just for my dog to purge a balloon. OUTRAGEOUS!

Overall, the experience felt less about care and more about gouging vulnerable pet owners who are already stressed because their pet needs urgent help. I was honestly surprised they didn’t charge for the air my dog was breathing in the office.

I love Dr. Debski's practical and honest approach. He has always makes time for us to talk through details. I appreciated that when it's an emergency they were able to squeeze us in for a quick consult despite his packed schedule.
Always great service!! Friendly staff, never pushy, and reasonable pricing. Highly recommend :)

Dr. Debski and Diana are an amazing primary care team. They are both lovely and make vet visits less stressful for my 2 cats.

In particular, they saved my cat’s life by referring me to an emergency vet right away when she was not doing well. The clinic was very responsive while we were dealing with her health issues. Will forever be grateful for it!

I’m insanely happy with Harbourfront Animal Hospital as my dogs vet clinic.

The front desk staff aka Diana is the sweetest lady. My dog loves her and is always happy to see her. He is not scared to go into this vet clinic for a change and that says a lot about this place.

Vet tech Nicole is always a sweet heart and is someone who my dog trusts when he goes into the back to be looked over.

Dr. Debski is amazing. He listens to our needs, he doesn’t over prescribe or offer solutions that will cost a lot of money. He certainly doesn’t try to sell me on something like my last vet did tirelessly every time I went in. He’s kind to my dog, he’s thorough, he’s trusted. The thing I like most about him, he helps you to understand how to do things properly (like brushing puppies teeth) and is very patient with my excessive questions, answering everything I need to know and more.

Essentially, I love my vet clinic. This is the right place for both of us…

I had a very disappointing experience with the front desk receptionist. She was extremely rude—among the most unpleasant interactions I’ve ever had. Without my consent, she contacted my current veterinarian, which was a serious overstep. She asked if I wanted her to do so I said no- she undermined me and did what she wanted. I told her I had all physical copies of my pets precious record. When I asked her about it, she became defensive and raised her voice, spoke down to me, belittled me and constantly interrupting me rather than listening. Her behavior came across as combative  and aggressive and focused more on being “right” than being helpful or respectful. Unfortunately, her attitude creates a very negative first impression and may be driving potential clients away from an otherwise reputable practice. Like me I will not be coming to this vet because I would rather deal with a kind receptionist than one who goes against my wishes.

Deplorable. The front desk staff completely violated my family members requests and contacted a clinic to obtain records without any consent, specially against her instructions. This is not a hospital where I would ever bring my pet, there is no trust or confidence in the staff. I cannot comment with respect to the Vet, however due to the front desk staff, you have lost 2 potential customers today.

If I could give zero stars, I would. This clinic is a prime example of predatory practices masquerading as veterinary care. I brought my puppy in for his initial vaccinations a few weeks ago, paying a hefty examination fee plus the already exorbitant vaccine costs. I was then told they couldn't administer the rabies vaccine at that time and I'd have to return in 7-10 days.
Fast forward a week, and when I call to schedule the second part of a vaccination series they couldn't complete the first time, I'm informed they will charge me ANOTHER $150 examination fee. My puppy was thoroughly examined just DAYS ago! This is nothing short of a cash grab. To "examine" a puppy that was just examined a week prior for an unfinished vaccination series is a blatant scam. They are exploiting pet owners by forcing redundant, unnecessary fees.
Avoid this clinic unless you enjoy being nickel-and-dimed for services you don't need. Their priority is clearly their bottom line, not the well-being of your pet or fair treatment of their clients. Completely disgusted and will be taking my business elsewhere.
Appointments are quickly given, staff is great, and the doctor takes the time to explain what's going on with your pet. Have been with them for at least 7 years, and feel so lucky to be a client!
Always a great experience for both my dogs.
It’s my dog’s vet. I like the services, the staff, and the veterinarian. Their availability is also pretty good. It’s just a bit pricey.
Always ask for a second opinion, never settle for one option.
Best general vet you can find in the area. We moved to Vancouver so wanted to say thank you.
Been taking our dogs here for five years now and really appreciate Dr Debski and his staff always giving our pets the best care under stressful circumstances.
The Harbourfront Animal Hospital has always taken great care of our pets.  The service is always very professional and kind towards us and the animals.  I highly recommend them!
Five stars all the way. Update: still five stars!

If I could give 0 stars I would, as I feel this vet has unnecessarily put the overall health and welfare of my pets at risk on numerous occassions. And this is coming from someone who blindly trusted Dr. Debski at Harbourfront animal hospital for close to 6-7 years, during which time I exclusively took my 2 small dogs to him for diagnosis/treatments. I think the ball dropped at our last visit about 3 weeks ago, when I took one of my dogs in for treatment for a broken NAIL on a declaw. I was trying to avoid the emergency vet since it was a Friday afternoon, and ironically, I ended up paying more than I probably would have at the emergency vet.

I was invoiced $1000 for a treatment that took no more than 2 hours and included charges for things which I think were simply there to drive up the price of the invoice as much as possible including a $155 full day hospitalization fee even though my dog was there for 2 hours, an $80 fee for a bandage application (her paw is the size of my thumb), and all of this was in addition to the $400 fee for the actual sedation/surgery. He also insisted on charging the $135 examination fee even though upon arrival he basically asked me what was wrong, and then did not come see me again to discuss after care upon pickup.

Which actually brings me to my main concern; how often this vet recommends sedation and surgery as a first line of treatment. When my dogs were younger I was not as worried about possible complications, but now that they are 8 and 9 years old, this is a real concern. I am honestly very surprised that not only has he pretty much recommended sedation/surgery each time I have been in to see him the last 2 years, but that he has never once addressed the added risk this poses to aging dogs. I was so disturbed by my last visit to Harbourfront Animal Hospital that I spent the next week calling other clinics to get second opinions and each vet/clinic said the treatment was excessive for a 10-pound dog. The worst part however is that I am not actually convinced that sedation even occurred, because it’s pretty standard to ask whether any food/drink has been consumed prior to any procedure that requires sedation, and on this occasion this was not asked even though it was 2pm and it was very likely she had already eaten. So either sedation (as indicated on the invoice) was not performed, or they just didn’t care that she had food/water in her system which could be life threatening. I don't know which scenario is worse.

Never once over the years had I questioned the treatment plans or invoices put before me at this clinic, but this last visit was so blatant in its attempt to charge me as much as they could, while at the same time providing the least standard of care for my dog, that it really made me question all the other treatments recommended and received over the years. On two occasions in the past, surgery was recommended by Dr. Debski which I now feel was unnecessary; once to remove a growth that turned out to be a papilloma, which typically resolves on its own in a few months. I paid close to $2000 for this procedure. Another time he recommended surgical removal of a lipoma which is basically a benign mass that I have since learnt does not require surgical removal unless it is fast growing and limits mobility, which was not the case. I paid close to $2000 for this surgery as well, and he also managed to somehow miss a second smaller growth which I had asked to be removed at the same time.

So overall, my takeaway is that this vet recommends surgery/sedation as a first line of treatment, even though surgery and sedation increases the risk of treatments/complications, especially for older dogs. Sedation/surgery also pushes costs into the thousands instead of hundreds, so I feel there has been a conflict of interest on some occasions when these recommendations were made. I will never step foot back in this clinic but I think I was very lucky that nothing serious happened during these various sedation/surgeries. I don’t want another pet to face unnecessary risks.

That doctor is amazing. He does his best to help us. He is very professional and he gives good advice. Thank you for your great service and your kindness.  Also the secretary is very helpful and very kind.
I recommend strongly that place.

We switched to Harbourfront years ago after being unhappy with our previous vet. The team is very knowledgeable and so kind. They made recommendations that kept our girl safe and healthy for 12 years. Thank you so much for everything!

My experience here was below par in multiple aspects, the only good thing about this place was the receptionist Diana who gave me more time and care than the actual doctor ever did. After spending almost $750, I still have no answers to what is wrong with my cat. I was transparent with the vet that I was in a financial bind at the moment and not expecting the emergency vet appt so I’d like all options available to me to try and find the best course of action to diagnose my cats condition and he only could come up with antibiotics and X-rays AFTER I had asked for them. My cat has been heaving with nothing coming up but has a raspy meow after and exacerbated breathing. This now happens multiple times a day after going to the vet. The doctor would barely listen to me so I tried to show him a video of the episode and said it was just a cough from laryngitis that antibiotics would heal, even though he never knew for sure if it was even laryngitis. So after over a week of antibiotics, my baby boy is still having the exact same things happen. Nothing has changed and he’s now started vomiting but since this clinic took $750 from me without an answer, I now can’t afford to take him somewhere else for a better answer. I understand it’s not their issue about my financial status but they could have been more up front about being unsure instead of just trying to take my damn money.. on top of it, I had to be the vet assistant in the room when the doctor was rough on my cat and had to tell the doctor three separate times to keep the door closed as my cat would try to escape. After the third time, my boy did try to escape and the doctor pounced on him with all fours and pinned him to the ground. I said I would grab my cat because what he did made me very uncomfortable. Not once did they call to check up on my cats condition or see how he was doing and now when I call with all these concerns telling them nothing has changed, the vet is on holidays and texted them to send me somewhere else… why did I even go to that clinic if you couldn’t help and just send me somewhere else after taking my money? I am utterly disgusted by this place…
Very good and caring doctor and nurse.

Not worth it. Extremely expensive, I took my puppy for her second and third vaccine, The first time they charged me for an "exam" for the first time and for the third vaccine they charged me again for an "exam"  AFTER she already got the …

Staff ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Doctor  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The staff are super friendly and helpful. The doctor is knowledgeable and …
